An incomplete copper alloy Roman strap distributor dating from AD 43 - 410. It is cross shaped in plan, with rounded angles between the arms of the cross, and flared arm terminals. None of the terminals are complete, but they have cusps which form a collar before another terminal element, possibly rounded. The front face is slightly concave.
